set.body:
Outcome

Run the final adversarial and workload court for the complete native Ravel, image4s, image4s-locus, and locus4s image architecture before merge or publication.

Acceptance court

- Asymmetric 2x3x5x7 coordinate, spatial-domain ordinal, full-sample order, reshape, and NIfTI oracles pass.
- Whole canonical, crop, flip, stride, singleton spatial view, and time-selection cases prove logical parity and expected storage sharing.
- Compile-time tests enforce Continuous, Categorical, and Mask separation.
- Same-size foreign grid, selection, and parcel domains fail closed without certified alignment.
- Allocation receipts verify zero-copy Ravel admission and views, one-buffer NDArray.build outputs, explicit materialization, and streaming I/O peak memory.
- Workload benchmarks cover voxelwise temporal regression, spatial smoothing or resampling, searchlight extraction, time-volume access, dense or sparse conversion, and NIfTI ingestion or writing without requiring one layout to win every workload.
- image, dataset, atlas, spatial, motion, threshold, MVPA, archive, viewer, and publication consumers pass their focused suites on JVM and Scala.js.
- sbt compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean; git diff --check passes; documentation and migration notes describe the breaking contract.
- The final branch contains no legacy compatibility bridge and is reviewed before merging to main or pushing.
set.title: Certify the native image architecture across correctness allocation and workloads
